### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

products are crafted from thick, heavy-duty steel, chosen for its exceptional durability and
strength.**

To further enhance durability, the gears and blade components undergo **specialized heat treatment
processes**, which significantly increase their hardness and longevity. These processes ensure our
tin opening systems maintain their sharpness and precision over time, providing reliable performance
in every use.

The critical gears and blade components undergo specialized heat treatment processes to harden and

performance, safety, and reliability before being approved for distribution.

## 15 Years With Can Openers

**We take immense pride in our manufacturing process, where quality is our foremost priority. Our
products are crafted from thick, heavy-duty steel, chosen for its exceptional durability and
strength.**

To further enhance durability, the gears and blade components undergo **specialized heat treatment
processes**, which significantly increase their hardness and longevity. These processes ensure our
tin opening systems maintain their sharpness and precision over time, providing reliable performance
in every use.

## 01

#### Material Selection

We begin by sourcing thick, high-quality steel plates known for its durability and strength,
ensuring a robust foundation for our tin opening systems.

Using advanced machinery, we carefully cut and shape the steel into components, paying close
attention to detail to maintain precision and quality.

## 03

##### Heat Treatment

The critical gears and blade components undergo specialized heat treatment processes to harden and
enhance their durability and longevity.

## 04

##### Quality Control

Every product undergoes rigorous testing and inspection to ensure it meets our high standards for
performance, safety, and reliability before being approved for distribution.

## Find Your Next Conveyance Solution

##### Learn about our product lines and how we can tackle your production challenges.

#### Timing Screws

Timing Screws and Feed Screws are used to move and guide products through packaging equipment
machines. They feed the equipment and can be utilized to create different orientation, pitch, and
spacing of the container prior to or in the packaging machine.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][72]

#### Container Handling Machines

Moving your products from application to application isn’t as simple as allowing them to flow down a
conveyor. Sometimes, they need to be in different or unique configurations in order to flow smoothly
into the packaging machine downstream.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][73]

#### Change Parts 

Change Parts are critical components to run different and new container sizes on any production
line. To perform changeovers, you need the right stars, guides, and feed screws on hand to reduce
downtime and maximize your throughput for different runs.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][74]

#### Drive Screw Units

Improve your packaging line with flexible timing screw drive units. Each standard drive unit is
equipped with timing screws [feed screws] to perform the necessary application on your line or in
conjunction with your equipment.

## About Nestly and Co

We started Nestly and Co with one simple belief — that every home deserves to be beautiful,
functional, and kind to the earth.

We know how overwhelming it can be to find home essentials that actually align with your values.
Products that look good, work well, and don't cost the planet in the process. That's exactly why we
created Nestly and Co — a curated destination for modern, eco-friendly home goods that make
intentional living effortless and accessible for everyone.

Every collection we carry — from our Kitchen & Dining Essentials to our Healing & Pampering goods,
our Living Room finds to our Rest & Restore bedroom pieces — is handpicked with purpose. We look for
natural materials, clean minimalist designs, and sustainable craftsmanship in everything we offer,
because we believe the details matter.

At Nestly and Co, we're not just selling home essentials. We're helping you build a home that
reflects who you are and the world you want to live in — one intentional piece at a time.

*Affordable. Sustainable. Beautifully simple.*

**Welcome to Nestly and Co. Welcome home.** 🌿

## services

##### 事業内容

[

#### ICT Integration

][9]


お客様のビジネスニーズを深く理解し、ITシステムの構築から運用・保守まで、ワンストップ提供します

異なるシステムをシームレスに統合し、ビジネスプロセスの合理化や効率化、生産性の向上を実現することで、
お客様のビジネス課題に最適なソリューションを提供いたします

[see more][10]

[

#### Business Consulting

][11]


お客様のビジネスの課題や機会を深く理解し、業界・市場動向を踏まえた最適な戦略策定をご提案します

経営戦略の策定や新規事業の開発、プロセスの最適化やデジタル化、組織変革や人材育成など、ビジネスに関わ
る様々な課題に対してコンサルティングサービスを提供しています

[see more][12]

[

#### DX Support

][13]


お客様のビジネスを深く理解し、業種や規模を問わず、持続可能で最適なDX推進をサポートします

DX実現に向けてお客様のニーズに応じて、DX戦略の策定から実行支援まで、幅広い領域でDX推進をサポートする
サービスを提供しています

[see more][14]

#### E-Commerce

オンラインプラットフォームを通じて、商品やサービスを提供することにより、顧客に対して便利でスムーズな
ショッピング体験を提供いたします。

品質の高い製品や、信頼性のある取引手続き、質の高いカスタマーサポートに重点を置き、顧客満足度を最大化
することを目指しています。

[openers online（準備中）][15]

## About Bulk URL Opener for Multiple Links or Websites

Opening multiple URLs seems hectic when you have to first copy and then paste each URL one by one in
different web browser tabs especially if your work is related to open multiple websites at a time
like web-hosting providers, and any digital marketing executive who checks bulk links at a time. So
how about copying all the URLs and paste it in a single text area and then just single click and all
websites are open without much hassle. There is no limit of URLs to open in multiple URL opener. You
can open 20-25 URLs at a time on a single click here.


## How to use Open Multiple URL Tool?
1. Simply just Copy (CTRL+C) and Paste (CTRL+V) the URLs in [**Open Multiple URL**][3] text area.
   Each Website URL or link must be on separate line
2. Click “GO NOW” button and your result will be processed and the web pages instantly start opening
   in the web browser
3. All listed URLs open in different browser tabs. This tool is very easy to use and free of cost.
   No downloading is needed, you can use it online from anywhere where there is Internet access


## Who should use Multiple Url Opener Website Tool?

Following users can use this tool for their work purpose

**SEO Webmasters:** If you are working as an SEO expert or a webmaster, this tool is really helpful.
As you have to access the number of websites and open all URLs at the same time. This is the
Multiple Web URL Opener tool where you can put all the URLs and open multiple URLs at a time.

**Web Data Research & Mining Experts:** If you have to search and find lot on web information and
need to bulk websites at a time then this Bulk URL Opener can help you in opening sites in single
click saving your time and efforts.

**Content Creators/ Writers:** Content writers have to research too much about their topic before
writing it down and then spin it and check for plagiarism to make it unique and relevant. For that
they have to open multiple URLs to collect the data, this tool is helpful for them.

## Where You can use it and its benefits

This tool is One-Click, No Install required tool and also known as bulk URL opener. Open Multiple
URLs tool not only helps SEO experts but content writers, web researchers, employers also. SEO
experts may need to check the page speed, simultaneous connections, site load time, and other site
related factors. For them, it is really helpful. Researchers may also use it to open multiple URLs
on a web browser.

## Bulk URL Opener Hardware/ Software Compatibility
* Open on any updated website browser like Mozilla Firefox
* Works on all editions of the Windows, Linux & IOS Operating systems
* Can be accessed on all the computers or smart devices like phones, tablets
* All major website browsers including Internet Explorer, Firefox, [Chrome][4], [Safari][5], and
  Opera support this tool
* If you try opening too many URLs/ links at one time, your web browser may freeze for a few seconds


# FAQ

#### [ How can I get the Web sites to show in tabs? ][6]

You can adjust your browser so that every URL opens in a new tab. Here’s how:

For Firefox click the Edit pull-down menu, select Preferences, then Tabs, then checkmark the “Force
links that open new windows to open in” line, and finally, select the “a new tab” option. Finally,
save your changes and exit.

#### [ How can I Use Open Multiple URL in Chrome ? ][7]

By Default chrome blocks all the popup windows. You need allow access of all the tabs from
http://www.openmultipleurl.com/

#### [ Its is not showing the URL’s, I entered ][8]

our browser may limit the number of pages that can be opened at one time, or you may have a pop-up
blocker enabled.

For older versions of Chrome click the Chrome menu in the upper right (the three bars) then click
Settings and then Show advanced settings… (at the bottom of the page). Under the “Privacy” heading,
click the Content settings button. Scroll down to the “Pop-ups” section and click Manage exceptions.
In the Add new hostname field, type “openmultipleurl.com” and select the Allow option. Click the OK
button. Unfortunately, this option does not seem to be available on newer versions of Chrome

#### [ What is your privacy policy? ][9]

Openmultipleurl.com collect only anonymous user statistics, no personally identifiable information.

## Что такое Polyzon

Один поиск — шесть крупнейших мировых каталогов STL. Без регистрации, без рекламы, на русском языке.

01

### Один поиск — шесть платформ

Вместо того чтобы открывать [Thingiverse][21], [Cults3D][22], [Printables][23], [MakerWorld][24],
[Creality Cloud][25] и [3DToday][26] по отдельности — пишете запрос один раз и получаете лучшие STL
со всех площадок.

02

### Поиск на русском

Запрос отправляется параллельно на шесть платформ — для мировых каталогов он автоматически
переводится на английский. Результаты можно сортировать по популярности, новизне, лайкам,
скачиваниям и фильтровать только бесплатные модели.

03

### Что можно скачать

[Подставки][27], [органайзеры][28], [драконы][29], [фигурки D&D][30], [машины][31], [танки][32],
[вазы][33], [игрушки][34], [антистрессы][35], [STL для ЧПУ][36], [брелоки][37].

04

### Поддерживаемые форматы

**STL** — стандарт 3D-печати, **3MF** — с цветами и настройками, **OBJ** — для рендера, **STEP** —
для CAD, **FBX** — для игр. Открываются в Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer.

## About Canslab

##### About Us

At Canslab, we believe the kitchen should be a place of joy, not struggle. Our mission is to
engineer premium, innovative kitchen gadgets that prioritize accessibility, safety, and modern
design. By combining industrial-leading motors with sleek aesthetics, we deliver unmatched
performance that transforms daily food preparation into an effortless, enjoyable experience for

were causing frustration and physical pain for individuals with arthritis or weak grips. Determined

daily visitors, spoken at conferences around the world, and yes, lost it all a couple of times too.
That’s kind of the point.

This blog is where I put everything I’ve learned, everything I remember, and everything I’m still
figuring out.

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

products are crafted from thick, heavy-duty steel, chosen for its exceptional durability and
strength.**

To further enhance durability, the gears and blade components undergo **specialized heat treatment
processes**, which significantly increase their hardness and longevity. These processes ensure our
tin opening systems maintain their sharpness and precision over time, providing reliable performance
in every use.

## 01

#### Material Selection

We begin by sourcing thick, high-quality steel plates known for its durability and strength,
ensuring a robust foundation for our tin opening systems.

## 02

#### Precision Manufacturing

Using advanced machinery, we carefully cut and shape the steel into components, paying close
attention to detail to maintain precision and quality.

## 03

##### Heat Treatment

The critical gears and blade components undergo specialized heat treatment processes to harden and
enhance their durability and longevity.

## 04

##### Quality Control

Every product undergoes rigorous testing and inspection to ensure it meets our high standards for
performance, safety, and reliability before being approved for distribution.

products are crafted from thick, heavy-duty steel, chosen for its exceptional durability and
strength.**

processes**, which significantly increase their hardness and longevity. These processes ensure our
tin opening systems maintain their sharpness and precision over time, providing reliable performance
in every use.

Hell Byte Studios’ debut title **Blood Reaver** is now available in Early Access on Steam, offering
a fast-paced, round-based, co-op FPS experience rooted in heavy metal and dark fantasy themes.
Players will face wave after wave of relentless demons, upgrading both weapons and abilities while
uncovering hidden lore in each map. Find out more or join the carnage via the game’s [Steam
page][13].

Slavic folklore comes alive in **Bylina** from Far Far Games and Digital Vortex Entertainment, now
launched on PC via Steam. Players control Kestrel, a would-be hero battling mythical foes and
exploring a semi-open world filled with secrets, nonlinear progression, and dark humor. PC players
who purchase Bylina within its first 30 days will receive the exclusive "Shroomie Power Armor";
console versions are set to arrive later in 2026—learn more on the [official Steam page][14].

**Tropico 7** has revealed its first gameplay teaser, promising fans new heights of island rule with
expanded archipelagos, campaign maps, and a robust political and city-building system. The latest
installment is set to arrive in 2026 for PC, Xbox, and PlayStation 5, complete with new terraforming
features and a reworked military system. For the full dev log and teaser, visit [Kalypso Media’s
blog][15].

**City States: Medieval** is now available in Early Access on Steam, letting players step into the
shoes of a 12th-century statesman managing a medieval city amid great kingdoms. Blending real-time
strategy, tactical combat, and trade mechanics, it features multiple starting cities and hero-led
campaigns shaped by player decisions. For more information, check out the [official Steam page][16].

The beloved medieval MMORPG **Gloria Victis** is back with a public playtest running until April 27,
marking the first major step towards its full relaunch after a long hiatus. Players can experience
large-scale PvP battles, robust crafting, and non-target combat, with in-game rewards promised for
playtest participants. Join the event or wishlist the game over on [Steam][17].

Peter Molyneux makes a grand return with **Masters of Albion**, launching in Early Access on Steam
April 22 for $24.99 USD. Combining god game mechanics, city-building, and real-time combat, Masters
of Albion delivers both nostalgic and innovative gameplay, alternating between open-ended
construction by day and intense defense phases by night. To see the latest footage and wishlist the
title, visit the [Steam page][18].

**Hello Neighbor 3** has entered pre-alpha on Steam, welcoming new and returning players to the
eerily charming town of Raven Brooks. The pre-alpha showcases expanded locations, a revamped
protagonist, improved stealth mechanics, and a unique objective system—making it the most accessible
entry point for franchise newcomers. Learn more about the game at its [official Steam page][19].

## Find Your Next Conveyance Solution

##### Learn about our product lines and how we can tackle your production challenges.

#### Timing Screws

Timing Screws and Feed Screws are used to move and guide products through packaging equipment
machines. They feed the equipment and can be utilized to create different orientation, pitch, and
spacing of the container prior to or in the packaging machine.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][72]
[A picture of several mechanical parts.]

#### Container Handling Machines

Moving your products from application to application isn’t as simple as allowing them to flow down a
conveyor. Sometimes, they need to be in different or unique configurations in order to flow smoothly
into the packaging machine downstream.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][73]

#### Change Parts 

Change Parts are critical components to run different and new container sizes on any production
line. To perform changeovers, you need the right stars, guides, and feed screws on hand to reduce
downtime and maximize your throughput for different runs.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][74]

#### Drive Screw Units

Improve your packaging line with flexible timing screw drive units. Each standard drive unit is
equipped with timing screws [feed screws] to perform the necessary application on your line or in
conjunction with your equipment.

## About Nestly and Co

We started Nestly and Co with one simple belief — that every home deserves to be beautiful,
functional, and kind to the earth.

We know how overwhelming it can be to find home essentials that actually align with your values.
Products that look good, work well, and don't cost the planet in the process. That's exactly why we
created Nestly and Co — a curated destination for modern, eco-friendly home goods that make
intentional living effortless and accessible for everyone.

Every collection we carry — from our Kitchen & Dining Essentials to our Healing & Pampering goods,
our Living Room finds to our Rest & Restore bedroom pieces — is handpicked with purpose. We look for
natural materials, clean minimalist designs, and sustainable craftsmanship in everything we offer,
because we believe the details matter.

At Nestly and Co, we're not just selling home essentials. We're helping you build a home that
reflects who you are and the world you want to live in — one intentional piece at a time.

*Affordable. Sustainable. Beautifully simple.*

## services

##### 事業内容

[

#### ICT Integration

][9]


お客様のビジネスニーズを深く理解し、ITシステムの構築から運用・保守まで、ワンストップ提供します

異なるシステムをシームレスに統合し、ビジネスプロセスの合理化や効率化、生産性の向上を実現することで、
お客様のビジネス課題に最適なソリューションを提供いたします

[see more][10]

[

#### Business Consulting

][11]


お客様のビジネスの課題や機会を深く理解し、業界・市場動向を踏まえた最適な戦略策定をご提案します

経営戦略の策定や新規事業の開発、プロセスの最適化やデジタル化、組織変革や人材育成など、ビジネスに関わ
る様々な課題に対してコンサルティングサービスを提供しています

[see more][12]

[

#### DX Support

][13]


お客様のビジネスを深く理解し、業種や規模を問わず、持続可能で最適なDX推進をサポートします

DX実現に向けてお客様のニーズに応じて、DX戦略の策定から実行支援まで、幅広い領域でDX推進をサポートする
サービスを提供しています

[see more][14]

#### E-Commerce

オンラインプラットフォームを通じて、商品やサービスを提供することにより、顧客に対して便利でスムーズな
ショッピング体験を提供いたします。

品質の高い製品や、信頼性のある取引手続き、質の高いカスタマーサポートに重点を置き、顧客満足度を最大化
することを目指しています。

[openers online（準備中）][15]

## Что такое Polyzon

Один поиск — шесть крупнейших мировых каталогов STL. Без регистрации, без рекламы, на русском языке.

01

### Один поиск — шесть платформ

Вместо того чтобы открывать [Thingiverse][21], [Cults3D][22], [Printables][23], [MakerWorld][24],
[Creality Cloud][25] и [3DToday][26] по отдельности — пишете запрос один раз и получаете лучшие STL
со всех площадок.

02

### Поиск на русском

Запрос отправляется параллельно на шесть платформ — для мировых каталогов он автоматически
переводится на английский. Результаты можно сортировать по популярности, новизне, лайкам,
скачиваниям и фильтровать только бесплатные модели.

03

### Что можно скачать

[Подставки][27], [органайзеры][28], [драконы][29], [фигурки D&D][30], [машины][31], [танки][32],
[вазы][33], [игрушки][34], [антистрессы][35], [STL для ЧПУ][36], [брелоки][37].

04

### Поддерживаемые форматы

**STL** — стандарт 3D-печати, **3MF** — с цветами и настройками, **OBJ** — для рендера, **STEP** —
для CAD, **FBX** — для игр. Открываются в Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer.

## The Tech behind Disposable Email Addresses

Everyone owns an email address each and every hour, for everything from connecting at work, with
business prospects, reaching out to friends and colleagues using the email address as an online
passport. Nearly 99% of all apps and services we sign-up today required an email address, likewise
to most shoppers loyalty cards, contest and offer entries, and more.

We all enjoy having an email address, but getting tons of spam emails each day doesn’t feel
comfortable. Furthermore, it’s entirely common for stores to have their databases hacked, leaving
your business email address at risk and more likely to end up on spam lists. Still, nothing done
online is 100% private. Thus you need to protect your email contact identity and best done using
disposable emails address.

## So, What Is A Disposable Email Address?

Recently, I found a bounce rate complex than usual on my latest email blast! I later realized the
surge of users (or bots) signing up for my services hiding their real identity using disposable mail
addresses.

Disposable email address (DEA) technically means an approach where a user’s with a unique email
address gets a temporary email address for your current contact. The DEA allow the creation of an
email address that passes validity need to sign-up for services and website without having to show
your true identity.

## From $1 Banner Ads to 30 Years Online

I made my first dollar on the internet in 1997 selling banner ads to strangers in AOL chat rooms.
People mailed me actual dollar bills. It was ridiculous and I was hooked immediately.

Since then I’ve built email lists with millions of subscribers, launched sites that hit 100,000+
daily visitors, spoken at conferences around the world, and yes, lost it all a couple of times too.
That’s kind of the point.

This blog is where I put everything I’ve learned, everything I remember, and everything I’m still
figuring out.
